title: iRacing Porsche GT3 Spa GP Pits Guide 2:15.9 Porsche 911 GT3 Spa 24 Endurance Track Guide

corners.braking: Brake at 100 sign, initially 55%, trail off to apex.
corners.line: Turn-in to left, apex wide, exit wide.
corners.exit: Throttle up to apex, lift for turn six, back on gas for turn seven.
corners.mistakes: Don't hit the wall, give yourself room.

corners.braking: Brake four or five car lengths before left-hand curb start.
corners.line: Brake, hold 50%, trail off to apex.
corners.exit: Pick up gas at 40%, lift for turn six, back on gas for turn seven.

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: brakes three or four car lengths ahead of the curb on the left, 45% long trail off
corners.line: trail off the brake all the way through until pointing at the pits
corners.exit: very gingerly back on the gas, reach 100% when rear won't kick out

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: brakes to about 15% trail it off
corners.line: get all the way to the outside
corners.exit: pick back up on the gas at the apex
corners.mistakes: lose left-hand tires off the track

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: brakes just ahead of the 50 board on the left, 35-40%
corners.line: use 50 board on the left as marker
corners.exit: back on the gas at the apex, straight up to 100%

corners.label: T12
corners.line: trail off to 3rd gear, apex, start picking up gas

corners.label: T14
corners.braking: 45% at curb ahead of left-hand side curb
corners.line: trail off, leave in 3rd gear, back on gas at apex

corners.label: T18
corners.braking: before white line after CrowdStrike banner
corners.line: braking in straight line towards outside
Little blip of gas, lift again

general_tips: Don't overdrive the car, maintain high apex speeds for fresher tires.
